what_differs: On 2026-08-27 Emily confirmed the deal's market country sets the sign-up payout currency (Canada=CAD, US=USD), stamped on the Sign-Up (not a player formula) and editable by Ops. No ticket records this rule. The only currency tickets (WAGR-404, WAGR-413, WAGR-415) derive 'Signup Currency' from the player's country and treat CAD as the fallback when the SLC has no country.
suggested_action: Add a ticket (or a comment on WAGR-5) that documents the deal-market-country rule, the CAD/USD mapping and Ops edit access, and confirm with WagerTech how the Player-level 'Signup Currency' (WAGR-404, from the client's Sep notes) relates to the Sign-Up record currency so the two rules do not conflict.
